newsitem.title: USA: Metris to use HNC Software for credit cards.
newsitem.headline: Metris to use HNC Software for credit cards.

text.p: Metris Cos Inc said Wednesday it will use software developed by First Data Corp and HNC Software Inc to maximize profits on its 1.4-million credit card portfolio.

The company said the software uses transaction-based statistical models that will enable Metris to target its customers for portfolio management and portfolio marketing programs. The models use a neural network technology to predict risk, attrition, revenue and profit, the company said.
Financial terms of the agreement were not announced.
Metris is a direct marketer of consumer credit products.
Its shares closed down 1/4 Wednesday at 28-5/8.
